shortDescription: Manage TLS certificate and key on F5OS devices.

options.name: city
options.description: This specifies the residing city of the certificate holder.

options.name: confirm_key_passphrase
options.description: This specifies the confirmation of the passphrase for the key. The value should be the same as C(key_passphrase).

options.name: country
options.description: This specifies the country of the certificate holder.

options.name: days_valid
options.description: This specifies the number of days the certificate is valid.

options.name: email
options.description: This specifies the email address of the certificate holder.

options.name: key_curve
options.description: This specifies the specific elliptic curve used in ECC. This parameter is required when C(key_type) is C(ecdsa) or C(encrypted ecdsa).

options.name: key_passphrase
options.description: This specifies the passphrase for the key.

options.name: key_size
options.description: This specifies the length of the key. This parameter is required when C(key_type) is C(rsa) or C(encrypted rsa).

options.name: key_type
options.description: This specifies the type of the key.

options.name: name
options.description: This specifies the common name of the certificate.

options.name: organization
options.description: This specifies the organization of the certificate holder.

options.name: province
options.description: This specifies the province or state of the certificate holder.

options.name: state
options.description: The certificate state. If C(absent), deletes the certificate if it exists. If C(present), the certificate is created.

options.name: store_tls
options.description: This specifies whether to store the certificate and key on the device.

options.name: subject_alternative_name
options.description: This specifies the subject alternative name of the certificate. This parameter is reuiqred for rSeries Platform.

options.name: unit
options.description: This specifies the organizational unit of the certificate holder.

options.name: version
options.description: This specifies the version of the certificate.
